DO NOT ORDER from this company. They are the parent company of Sub D. You will not know which company you are ordering from until after you have made a purchase. Furthermore, you don't find out until afterwards that you have been signed up for a subscription. It's a complete nightmare trying to get any of this resolved with them. Perricone MD will tell you that Sub D is a company using their logo, made a strikingly similar website, puts Perricone MD's number and there is nothing that they can do and you need to contact that company. You contact Sub D and they say that Perricone MD is their parent company. They make you run in circles and end up making you feel like you are in the wrong. It's quite disturbing and I'm shocked that a company can get away with this in 2025
I have used this product for the last five years. It works well and diminishes fine lines. It works great on marionette lines around the mouth.

I have been using this serum for 3 years. I get compliments on my skin all the time and credit this product for my minimal lines or wrinkles. The only improvement needed is a better pump in their 6oz bottle.

avis.titre: A Smart Investment for Healthier Skin
avis.texte: I've been using Perricone MD Cold Plasma Plus+ for a few weeks now, and I'm really impressed. The texture is silky and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. My skin looks noticeably smoother and more even, especially around my cheeks and forehead. It also gives a subtle, healthy glow that I love.

I have used Pericone for many years. My results have been amazing. I recently received the Duo and it was defective. I have tried to get satisfaction but to no avail Im apparently stuck with a product I cannot use.

I bought this with a few other products and broke out in a bumpy rash! I usually have very smooth skin and I dont have allergies or sensitive skin at all! Contacted the team explaining my concerns and sent photos, I haven't heard a response about a refund! NEVER BUY IT
I love Perricone MD products! They make my skin glow and have glass skin!!!!!

avis.titre: Good serum - love the XL bottle
avis.texte: Big fan of this serum - so i bought the giant bottle. It can be a little temperamental when pumping it out - but I haven't had too many issues, I tend to use this serum for face/neck/chest, so one full pump is perfect. I have decanted into a small jar for holidays as needed. Serum can feel a little tingly on my skin if it's already irritated, but it hasn't caused any issues and dissipates pretty quick.

I'm on my third or fourth jar now. Can't live without it. Very expensive but I get 3-4 months out of 1 jar. Smooth, no scent, feels great on the skin and absorbs quickly. My skin tone and evenness has improved and I have had less breakouts since incorporating into my routine. I won't be without it.

I'm on my third or fourth jar now. Can't live without it. Very expensive but I get 3-4 months out of 1 jar. Smooth, no scent, feels great on the skin and absorbs quickly. My skin tone and evenness has improved and I have had less breakouts since incorporating into my routine. I won't be without it.

I fell in love with the samples Ingot of the cold plasma + serum and bought the 6 oz bottle and it unfortunately comes in the WORST packaging. The pump is not meant for something of this viscosity so it shoots out and also dispenses way too much, so SO much product is wasted.

I just started using this as my regular YSL serum is hard to find due to supply chain issues. I tried using various amounts-- this product is so concentrated it works well at low amounts, putting too much on very much irritated my skin and caused a break out. Of note, I ordered the new 6oz size and the packaging is absolutely terrible causing so much wasted product. The bottle and pump, including the tube diameter, are the same as one for a body cream, causing an enormous amount to spurt out with every pump; the pump is also very stiff cheap plastic and it's impossible to press lightly for less product. Instead opening the bottle every time for use is not a solution as it would be both very inconvenient as one would need to scoop out with another sanitized tool given the bottle depth, and it also exposes the product to oxidation and contaminants. So much extra unneeded product comes out with the pump that effectively *at least* two-thirds to three-quarters (67--75%) is wasted. I don't usually write reviews, but found this extremely unreasonable given the very high price point of the product. I would like to give PMD products a real chance, but both the formulas AND packaging have to be of high quality and consideration.

The product wasnt a good fit for me- it made my itchy and broke me out.. might not happen to you but happened to me. But why I'm giving this a 2 star review is because of the smell of the product and the texture. The smell is like a sour chemicals and the texture feels like someone put really fine sand in it, very unpleasant to put on.

I tried a sample of this and liked it so I bought the super sized version last Christmas. My skin is brighter, fine lines are less noticeable, and my redness has improved. I sometimes use this in combination with the cold plasma moisturizer, chia oil, and essence BUT this is the only product I use every day. It's a game changer.

Purchased after receiving a sample and so thankful. It firms, hydrates and smooths my skin, overnight. Thicker than the typical serum, it absorbs pretty quickly. Although I have sensitive skin, there is zero irritation. My skin feels fantastic. My strong preference is for anything other than a jar, but this formulation is magical. Yes, I'll be trying other Dr P products.

Received a free sample. It absorbed very quickly without any stickiness or greasiness. My skin felt good but looked the same. The next morning was much the same - skin felt good but no visible improvements. Considering the price snd unhygienic container, I am unlikely to purchase.

I received this as a sample. I couldnt get over the smell but i tried it anyways. I felt like i was pitting mud on my face it felt so heavy. I was FLAGGERGASTED when I went to search it up and saw the high price tag. Its a no for me (and for you too).
Nice feel, texture. Not sure yet if effective but feels great going on.

The consistency of this item is so great because it really absorbs and heals the skin. I think this is the hero sku of the cold plasma line. The scent is light and favorable compared to other more floral scents!

avis.titre: Cold Plasma Plus+ Advance Serum concentrate

I love the way it goes on, sinks right in, smells wonderful. I use both morning and night prior to using any moisturizer. It's the best!! Wouldn't be without it!!

The Cold Plasma + Serum is all around a miracle worker for my skin... it has smoothed my skin texture, noticeably decreased the pore size on my t-zone, and surprisingly has also toned down the redness of my skintone around my nose. And then the HA Intensive Moisturizer leaves my skin feeling so refreshed and hydrated and layers perfectly and smoothly over this serum. These two products have been transforming my skin and I can see such a difference both when I am wearing makeup and without. I love this product. I think it's one of the best on the market and worth every penny. I notice a smoother, tighter, lifted look that over time has improved my skin as I age. I am 65, so my skin care has to work. This is an excellent everyday routine that pays off.
I love all the Perricone products. The serum is wonderful to even out skin tone , A little goes a long way and I can definitely see a difference when I don't use the serum.

I've been using Perricone MD for a couple of years now. I've tried the neuropeptide line which I love but ran out of. I decided to try the Cold Plasma + Advanced Serum Concentrate when they ran Black Friday promotions. I use the Cold Plasma Eye Cream and like it- so I figured why not try the serum too? It goes on smooth and doesn't smell like anything. I'm not in love with the pump bottle- the pump sometimes gets stuck in one position or sometimes too much product comes out- but that's not a huge deal. As with all Perricone MD products, a little goes a long way. I use this on my face and neck as directed and use the rest on the backs of my hands. I'm turning 57 next month and no one can guess my age- I usually get early 40s!! I'll keep using Perricone MD- I really do see results.

I bought 2 pieces of larger one (149ml each) 2 weeks before with nice discount which I just found it is out of stock right now. I started to apply it while after shower. Instead of saying it is a cold cream, I would say it is a concentration. After applying it to the hand first, it is going to turn white like the cream and then I had a small rub treat with face. It's not greasy at all, it gets absorbed quickly. I first treated my face with the tonic water and then used perricond's lipidated vitamin C. The name seems to be CCC. Then I applied this essence. According to online reviews, the old version is a bit fishy, but this one has almost no taste, maybe It is a new version. You can score 85 points on the face for the first time. In summary, it is not irritating, tasteless, and has a good moisturizing effect. The anti-aging effect remains to be seen. Some people will treat it as a cream, but it is not enough to be a cream, and it needs to be superimposed. Oily creams will work better.
I like how it feels on my skin. I've been using it for years and I think it slows down my skin's aging. Everyone thinks I look younger than my age.

I have tried so many topicals for my face. I love the products. The products help take away the years of sun damage along with aging. I do have a limited financial income so I do take advantage of the sales They are the best! Thank you!

I have been using Dr Perricone products for some time now! I tried many many other products but I always come back to Perricone

This is and always has been my must have!! Goes on after cleansing and the perfect canvas for the rest of your skincare!! Love love love!!!!
This is by far my favorite Perricone product. Texture, tone, brightness, smoothness are all improved. Sooo worth the price as a little goes a long way!

Got this free in the .4 oz jar and have used it all & buying more ! I will not go without this product. Only used it at night and woke to obvious results . That is how I judge a product and this one did not disappoint . Love this product !

avis.titre: One of my two skincare essentials
avis.texte: I wish I'd discovered this stuff 20 years before I did, honestly. I'm 50 years old and have been using this product for about seven years now. Before this discovery, I didn't leave home without primer, full coverage foundation, and finishing powder. These days it's usually just the powder. My pores are smaller (huge pores were one of my skin complaints), and my fine lines have diminished. additionally, I haven't gained any new wrinkles (and it's been a hard seven years!). Cold Plasma+ in the morning and Sunday Riley Good Genes at night have completely changed my fussy, combo (schizophrenic is more accurate), aging, rosacea-prone skin. I try to get it on sale when possible, but it's worth the high price for these results. Caveat: this is not a moisturiser; it is a treatment. Unless your skin is dryness immune, you should top this with a moisturiser.

With a little bit of hesitation I invested in these products, which I've been using for only two weeks but with discipline. Well, for Christmas we have few close friends over for dinner and for my amusement, EVERYONE complimented my skin and my neck. I feel and see improvement, but the fact the not one but everyone notice it really made my day. As to the plasma odor, that some talked about, I don't mind and to be truthful I have not even notice a smell.
This should be sold with a moisturizer. Although I am familiar with this product and have used their products I like to feel more moisture on my face.

My mom and I have both used this product consistently for months (bought it multiple times) and saw no results. I am in my 20s with fine lines and my mom is in her 50s with more deep set wrinkles. For both types of concerns, the cold plasma did NOT work. We spent hundred on Perricone and used it religiously to ultimately see no results.

avis.titre: One for all, all in one
avis.texte: So this serum concentrate does everything you need in just one simple serum concentrate. I apply this product after No Rinse exfoliating peel, and follow with the CCC+Ferulic brightening complex, the Cold Plasma Sub D and Cold Plasma eye cream, finishing it all off with the vitamin C Ester Photo Brightening Moisturizer SPF 30. The Cold Plasma line is expensive but worth every penny. My skin looks amazing. As for the CCC+ Ferulic Brightening complex, I feel it's redundant and unnecessary, so I will most probably be returning that product for a refund.
I love this product. I have been using it for 2 years. AT AGE 58 I feel good about my skin. I also use the one for the neck.
This product might be wonderful but I can't get past the smell. It makes me gag. So expensive. What's with the odor?....

quick tip: ulta currently offers a perricone trio and you get the eye, neck, and the face plasma (same size) for $10+ . got this for my mom and she absolutely LOVES it! it has definitely minimized wrinkles, especially around the forehead area and her skin looks flawless!

(I am 35 with normal to oily skin.) This feels very greasy/slick, and not in a might be helping way, but almost in a silicone primer type way that makes you feel like you are putting gunk into your pores needlessly. Anyways, as with a product that packs my pores like this does, this left me with bumps/pimples on my face. FYI: I do NOT have sensitive skin. I am sure it was this product because I eliminated it for a few days and then reintroduced it. I am not impressed with this brand at all to be quite honest. I gave this to my 65 year old father who is having trouble remembering to put a face care product on before bed. (Lol) Will update if great results are seen there. :)

avis.titre: Fabulous product for my aging skin

Somehow it helps my skin feel more moist, so I no longer feel like my face is dried out all the time, even when I visit my daughter in the southwest. I used to blame the feeling of dryness on my previous moisturizer, but now realize it was the serum I used to use. Overall, this is a great success.

I ordered my first jar through the FABFITFUN Seasonal Box. I liked it so much I ordered it again thru the Perricone site. It keeps my face nice and soft and helps with the wrinkles. I was out for about 2 weeks and boy could I see the difference! I would recommend the product.
